hero_title: Your Komga library, wherever you read.
hero_body: Manga, comics, webtoons and ebooks. Find your next book, pick up where you left off, and take a few stories with you.
availability: Android is available. Native iOS validation is still pending.
hero_caption: A familiar place for your next chapter.
reading_title: A good read, on your terms.
reading_body: Your books stay on your Komga server. Inkora brings them to your phone or tablet, with layouts for every kind of story.
resume_body: Continue your current book from Home. Filter your shelves without losing your place, browse ebook authors and reopen recent reads from your history.
offline_title: A few books for the road.
offline_body: Download books or whole series, follow transfers and read offline. Optionally remove a series’ finished downloads after at least 24 hours. Progress syncs to Komga when you reconnect.
personal_body: Choose reading direction, page layout and gestures, with reading defaults for each visible library. Adjust ebook typography, add bookmarks and open book or series details from the reader.
gallery_body: A clear view of your books, from a phone in one hand to a tablet on the sofa.
shot_home: Inkora Home on a phone, with reading progress and book covers
shot_tablet: Inkora Home in landscape, with a wide catalogue grid
shot_series: Series details on a phone, with book count and reading action
shot_series_tablet: Series details on a tablet, with information and volumes side by side
shot_appearance: Appearance settings with themes and portrait and landscape cover counts
shot_download: Series download confirmation before books enter the queue
caption_series: The series, and the next book to read.
caption_appearance: Your colours. Your preferred cover size.
capture_note: Actual app screens with fictional books and original demonstration artwork. Screenshots show development; published releases may differ. The app is available in twelve languages; screenshots are in English.
kmm_title: Give your library the details it deserves.
kmm_body: Komga Meta Manager is the metadata companion for your collection. Fetch missing information, review proposed changes, then publish them to Komga. Open Inkora when it is time to read.
kmm_note: Two independent projects for the same library. Neither requires the other; both are independent of Komga.
start_body: Install the Android APK, enter your server address and sign in with an API key or your username and password. Choose your visible libraries and open your first book.
start_note: Inkora provides neither books nor a hosted Komga server. You keep control of your collection.
footer: A little more time for reading.
libraries_body: Keep several Komga connections, edit each account and choose its visible libraries. Explore series details, author pages and catalogue links, then select volumes from a floating toolbar.
quality_body: Set image scaling and colour filters for all image formats together. Adjust sharpening on the same page, and manage preloading separately.
appearance_body: Choose from twelve light and dark palettes, including Mint and Lavender. Follow the system theme, adjust covers for each orientation and restore a settings page to its defaults.
shot_ebook: Individual ebook details with cover, synopsis, author and reading action
caption_ebook: Every ebook has its own place.
shot_quality: Image quality settings with shared scaling, colour filters and sharpening
caption_quality: One set of image controls, for every format.
shot_transfer: Settings backup and import with file options
caption_transfer: Bring your preferences and bookmarks along.
shot_pinned: Tablet catalogue with the three compact toolbar groups attached to the header
caption_pinned: Browse freely. Your controls stay within reach.
